from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification, TrainingArguments, Trainer
from datasets import load_dataset

tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("{{base_model}}")
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("{{base_model}}", num_labels={{num_labels}})

ds = load_dataset("json", data_files={"train": "train.jsonl", "eval": "eval.jsonl"})
def tk(b): return tok(b["text"], truncation=True, padding="max_length", max_length=256)
ds = ds.map(tk, batched=True)

args = TrainingArguments(output_dir="{{output_dir}}", num_train_epochs=3, per_device_train_batch_size=8, eval_strategy="epoch")
Trainer(model=model, args=args, train_dataset=ds["train"], eval_dataset=ds["eval"], tokenizer=tok).train()
